newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha eases with crude, n+a price eases.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha eases with crude, n+a price eases.

text.p: NWE naphtha was easier on Friday as crude futures continued their downward march but an industry function in Scandinavia stifled business, traders said.
June swaps were talked in the range $182/$183 a tonne cif NWE, with July still in a contango of around $1.

Paraffinic naphtha was in poor supply and petrochemical demand was good, given that alternative feedstocks were still expensive. Premiums for high paraffinic naphtha were pegged at around $3 over full-range material.
Premiums for n+a naphtha were expected to dwindle as gasoline prices fell sharply.
